post_run_diagnosis.cause: The first inverse-domain weighting implementation normalized each label weight total to 1.0. The calibration LogisticRegression therefore received total sample weight 2.0 and was strongly regularized toward 0.5 probabilities.
post_run_diagnosis.disposition: Retained as a failed controlled run; V3 rescales per-domain weights so each class total is half the sample count before calibration. V2 artifacts were not selected or promoted.
